maya_marketing: Quick alert — we discovered a minor discrepancy in the benchmark graphs; postponing publish 20m. New target 10:20 PST (embargo 11:20 UTC). Please hold all outbound sends until I confirm. Assets: https://drive.redwood/bench/pack_final.zip. @josh_ops can you pause the CDN purge?
josh_ops: Pausing purge jobs now. I'll reschedule prewarm for T-25m before 10:20 and share job id. Also found a cache rule that may drop ?ref params for embeds, fixing in staging.
cecilia_pm: Legal wants a clarifying sentence about sample cohorts. I added wording to the one-pager; @trent_data can you verify numbers match the CSV?
trent_data: Checking CSV now. The numbers match once we exclude 2 outlier runs — updated CSV in drive and noted footnote.
anna_marketing: Social queue hold placed. I'll update the scheduler once we lock. Please confirm OG image won't change after the final graphs.
press_bot: Notifying embargo list of minor timing change. Embargo remains in place; flagged contacts will get an updated timestamp at publish.
lisa_seo: Will hold robots and canonical checks until T-15m. If slug changes, reply here now.
evan_support: Support standby confirmed. I'll prepare an FAQ addendum for the revised stat explanation.
maya_marketing: New short checklist to paste in PRs:
1) T-50m: FINAL assets locked + legal sign-off
2) T-30m: CDN prewarm + redirect checks
3) T-20m: SEO OG swap + canonical check
4) T-10m: Social queue armed; staging smoke
5) T-5m: Rate-limit bump and pager assigned
6) Publish 10:20 PST: flip + press send
7) T+5m: monitor errors/ingestion; quick rollback ready

maya_marketing: Please react :eyes: if you're good with new time or reply with blockers. I'll run the final preflight at 09:58 PST.
